plan.comment: Requests first: conductor 069 (RV2: every member reviews the full book's sections in its lane, principles 11 to 24 for me; findings in my own folder mapped to file, line, principle and severity; a request letter to the section's writer; which sections passed to the conductor); writer2's 005 (the loop's cycle drawn twice, in 01 and 12: my call); writer4's 001 (the book team's twelve cards: may the roll call carry them). The work: answer both questions; review the full book's 00 and 00b (Start here and the introduction) in my lane, with a reviewer step doing the line checks; findings in team/storyteller/reviews/150/, a letter to the writer, the result to the conductor. Every review step as the reviewer agent. Writes only chapter-plan/, team/storyteller/, comms/mail/storyteller/, mailroom storyteller__* letters. Push in the background.

pre_review.comment: The plan stays inside scope.writes: team/storyteller/** covers reviews/150/ and the mailroom storyteller__* letters. Other lanes are read only, review steps run as the reviewer agent, and there is no stop condition, secret or cross-member write.
